project_info.theme: Minimal teaser for Hau Giang lotus mineral sun fluid launch
project_info.color_palette: Lotus Pink, Cream White, Sky Blue, Soft Rose

main_subject.detail: An extreme macro beauty teaser where a pink lotus petal fills almost the entire frame, with fine petal texture and dew droplets visible, partially revealing the gold Cocoon wordmark on a white product bottle tucked in the lower right corner.
main_subject.style: Luxury skincare teaser photography, abstract floral macro, restrained launch-preview visual

composition_elements.text: Visible text is partial brand wording 'cocoon ORIGINAL VIETNAM' on the bottle in the lower right.
items: Top Left: Soft pink lotus petal surface with delicate natural striations and moisture droplets.
Top Right: Pale sky-blue negative background peeking around the edge of the petal.
Bottom Left: Darker magenta shadow area across the petal adding depth and mystery.
Bottom Right: Small cropped portion of a white Cocoon bottle with gold logo text partially exposed.
Center/Background: The petal dominates the composition like a veil over the product.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Gentle translucent petal glow, silky shadows, premium teaser ambiguity, dewy close-up realism

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality advertising poster for a minimal teaser of a skincare launch. Centerpiece is a giant pink lotus petal covering almost the entire frame, showing fine petal texture, dew droplets, and a soft shadow gradient. Background is barely visible pale sky blue. Surrounding elements: a tiny cropped white Cocoon bottle in the lower right with partial gold logo text 'cocoon ORIGINAL VIETNAM'. Keep the abstract macro crop, premium mystery, and floral-teaser mood. Technical style: high fidelity macro beauty photography, soft macro beauty lighting, gentle translucent petal glow and dewy close-up realism, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
prompt.negative_prompt: dark, gloomy, blurry, flat 2d, low resolution, distorted text, messy typography, muted colors, black and white, ugly, deformed shapes, watermark, signature, cropped

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: When recreating with gpt-image-2, attach the original image as a mandatory composition reference. The result should stay abstract and tightly cropped; do not reveal more of the product than the original teaser does.
